hypothesis: The source-proven full-model dual-cache comparator remains exact and net-positive after the installed seq_lens_cpu support repair, once its only component invocation is held until the cached server has completed CUDA-graph capture and is actually accepting requests.

evidence.interpretation: The controller treated adapter attachment plus a live container as readiness. Every connection was refused before server request entry, NGRAM execution, or candidate CUDA, so this is an invalid infrastructure attempt and the scientific component remains unconsumed.
evidence.marker_correction: The component-side activation preamble wrote science_started=true before making a network request. The durable execution terminal and bench ledger correctly supersede that local preamble: science_started=false and candidate_cuda_invocation_started=false.

readiness_gate: Start the cached server with the already-installed seq_lens_cpu repair and persist the exact installed source identity.
Keep the component process absent until the server log contains both 'Capture cuda graph end' and 'The server is fired up and ready to roll!'.
Require the server process and container to remain live and localhost:30000 to accept a TCP connection after those log markers.
Do not use a generation request as a readiness probe.
immediate_experiment.component: After every readiness gate passes, run the still-unconsumed pinned full-model dual-cache comparator through the exact NGRAM verification consumer once.
immediate_experiment.science_marker: Set science_started only after the server accepts the component request and request entry is durably observed; a client-side activation preamble or attempted socket connection is not science.
immediate_experiment.conditional_exact_c32: Run only if every existing component exactness, cache-lifecycle, and positive-net-timing gate passes.
immediate_experiment.mutable_environment: Reuse the named warm H200, exact cached image, checkpoint, source, compiler caches, and single-model launch path.

stop_rules: Do not launch the component until every non-generating readiness gate passes.
Launch at most one cached replacement server and submit the still-unconsumed component at most once under this binding.
Do not count client preamble, connection attempts, or refused requests as science_started or candidate CUDA.

If a recoverable pre-science support failure occurs with enough time for one material correction, retain the claim and make that correction under this same project; a server-count limit must not force premature release.
Do not run exact c32 unless the full-model component is exact and net-positive under all prior gates.
Do not claim quality preservation or deployability, train, alter checkpoint values, or replay the completed placement comparison.
